summary: Availability + deal-scheduling feature tested end-to-end on web + shared backend. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (1 skipped due to client doc-gating). Frontend web: admin availability modal fully functional (open, 7 weekday rows, slot select, blocked-date add/chip/remove, save, reload-persists). Client gets 403 on /api/workspace/availability (correct). Client /dashboard → Underwriting Call tab correctly shows gated screen (1/22 docs approved). Workspace calendar regression confirmed (grid renders, meeting chips, upcoming list, accept/decline testids wired, backend respond test green). DealScheduler person-picker UI could NOT be exercised in a real browser because every available test account is still doc-gated (see 'issues' below) — the person-picker is covered via backend tests only.

integration_issues.issue: The person-picker + sched-slot buttons could not be rendered in-browser with any available test credential because: (1) client@thedoxs.com has only 1 of 22 required docs approved, so DealScheduler shows the gated screen; (2) staff viewing another client's Schedule tab are also gated (gate uses viewer's own /prescreen/me as noted by main agent). Backend endpoints (/api/deals/{cid}/team, /api/deals/{cid}/slots) and 409 enforcement verified via pytest, but the UI binding (sched-person-* click -> fetch slots -> sched-slot-HH:MM render -> POST meetings) was not exercised against a live DOM. Main agent should either approve all documents for client@thedoxs.com in seed OR expose a non-client preview path for QA.

issues: Non-blocking: dev-overlay injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> elements of the slot select, triggering a React hydration warning in console ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Appears to come from the frontend inspection toolkit, not AvailabilityEditor code itself.

action_items: Consider decoupling DealScheduler gating from /prescreen/me when the viewer is staff/admin so QA (and real underwriters/partners) can reach the person-picker on a client's Schedule tab without first approving every client doc.
Optional seed enhancement: pre-approve all 22 required docs for client@thedoxs.com so the client-self booking happy path is testable in UI without manual approval steps.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/workspace/availability.py: common_slots returns [] when NO selected person has availability — but the API wraps this with unconstrained=True, so UI falls back to the free-time input. Behaviour is correct, just subtle; consider a doc comment on common_slots that '[]' can mean either 'nobody has availability' or 'intersection empty' and that callers must use all_have_no_availability to disambiguate.

server.py create_deal_meeting: participant lookup uses db.users.find_one({'id': pid}) — if a participant_id is bogus the slot still gets validated (returns ok=True because validate_slot skips users with no availability doc). Not a bug today, but worth adding an existence check to prevent silent accept of unknown ids.

frontend DealScheduler: when slots.unconstrained is true AND the picked persons DO have availability but intersection is empty, backend returns unconstrained=False+slots=[] so sched-no-slots renders correctly. Good. No change needed.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (admin availability + calendar regression fully verified; DealScheduler UI not reachable with current seed data)

seed_data_creation: Admin availability saved via UI with blocked_dates=['2026-07-04'] and Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 slot=30. Underwriter availability also saved via API (same schedule). These persist and are needed for the /api/deals/{cid}/slots assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_availability_scheduling.py (pytest, hits REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api). Admin modal selectors confirmed: [data-testid=availability-button], [data-testid=availability-modal], [data-testid=avail-on-0..6], [data-testid=avail-start-0..6]/avail-end-0..6, [data-testid=avail-slot], [data-testid=avail-block-date], [data-testid=avail-block-add], [data-testid=avail-blocked-<YYYY-MM-DD>], [data-testid=avail-save]. Note: workspace Btn component renders id prop as data-testid (NOT html id), so always target with [data-testid=...]. DealScheduler UI needs client's docs fully approved OR gating relaxed for staff before person-picker is browser-testable.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs filed. Only an environment/testability note: the shared gating logic in DealScheduler (uses viewer's /prescreen/me regardless of role) blocks UI-level exercise of the new person-picker. Backend contract fully verified via pytest.
